QUOTE: "Option A, compile time (no runtime pointer, no setter): ... `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`" and "Option B, runtime (only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` defined): `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free);`" plus "In this mode `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is not declared, so calling it is a compile error."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime setter with function pointers. It also says that defining the macros removes the runtime setter, so the two cannot be combined.
